description: Since protocol 0.26: save a library sketch's code for one board into a folder the user chose, as the Arduino IDE opens it: <dir>/<id>/<id>.ino. Nothing is overwritten (an existing folder fails) and nothing is built. Prebuilt firmware has no code to save.

reuse.description: Since protocol 0.29: if the sketch was saved there before, keep it as it is (it may have been changed) and return it, with existing: true. Default false: an existing folder fails.

libraries.description: Arduino libraries the sketch needs, to install in the Arduino IDE.

existing.description: Since protocol 0.29: the sketch was there already (reuse).
